messages:
Theo (new-hire): Hey team — I accepted the GitHub invite but I can't see private repos under the org. My profile shows my personal account membership. When I open a repo link I get 'You don't have access' and 'You must authenticate with SAML SSO'. I accepted the invite from my personal browser session; did I mess something up? @Maria?
OnboardBot (bot): Hi Theo — welcome! Quick checklist: 1) Enable 2FA on your GitHub account. 2) Accept SAML SSO for 'redwood-inference' at https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso. 3) Make sure the invite was sent to the same verified email you log in with. Reply 'resend' if you need People Ops to send a fresh invite.
Maria (people-ops): I just re-sent the invite to theo.work@gmail. If you have multiple GH accounts, accept the invite while signed into the correct one (or open the link in an incognito window). LMK if it still redirects.
Theo (new-hire): Thanks — I actually have a personal GH account (theo@gmail) and a work one (theo.work@gmail). The invite went to theo.work, but when I click it it opens my personal account. How do I claim the invite for the work account?
Alex (eng): Two quick options: sign out of GitHub then sign in as theo.work before clicking the invite link, or open the invite in an incognito/private window and sign in as the work account. You can also switch accounts from the avatar menu.
Theo (new-hire): Tried incognito, still gets rerouted to personal. The invite URL is https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/invitation/abcd — when I visit it I see 'Already a member' but repos are still hidden.
Jordan (eng-infra): Sounds like either your emails are shared between accounts or SSO hasn't been authorized. Go to GitHub -> Settings -> Emails and confirm theo.work@gmail is verified and primary for the work account. Then visit the org SSO page; after accepting the invite there should be an 'Authorize SSO' or 'Grant access' button.
Sam (devex): If you prefer, drop the email you used to sign into your GH work account and I can invite that specific account to the eng teams. Also useful: run 'gh auth status' after signing in to confirm which account the CLI sees.
Theo (new-hire): Screenshot DM'd. I think GH auto-merged because I used the same recovery email. Maria — can you revoke and explicitly re-send to theo.work@gmail?
Maria (people-ops): Done — revoked and re-sent to theo.work@gmail just now. Check Spam if you don't see it; the invite should contain an INV- code in the subject.
OnboardBot (bot): Reminder: Org requires SAML SSO. After accepting the invite, go to https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso and click 'Authorize SSO' to fully enable access to private repos.
Theo (new-hire): Accepted the new invite while signed in as theo.work — I now see a banner to 'Authorize SSO' and after authorizing the private repos appeared. I can access samples/infra. Thanks everyone :tada:
Alex (eng): Awesome. If you need additional repo perms beyond your default team access, request access from the repo page (button 'Request access') or ping @Sam and we'll route to the codeowners.
Sam (devex): Approved Theo's request to samples/infra just now. Quick test: 'gh repo clone redwood-inference/samples-infra' should work for you.
Theo (new-hire): Clone succeeded. One last q — is there a canonical list of repos I should join, or is team membership enough?
Maria (people-ops): Team membership is the source of truth. I'll add you to 'eng-backend' and 'eng-sre' per the leads' recommendation; you should get team invites shortly.
Jordan (eng-infra): FYI if SSO ever acts up again, try clearing cookies or using an incognito window and always accept the invite while authenticated to the target work account. Also check GitHub -> Organizations -> redwood-inference -> 'Authorize SSO' if prompted. :thumbsup:
